[b][color=#ffff00]How to play[/color][/b]
Make objects of the same kind collide to merge them and generate a bigger. The bigger the objects is, the more points you get. Don't let them reach the upper limit of the screen.

[b][color=#ffff00]Controls[/color][/b]
Tap and hold to move the cursor. Release to spawn the next object on top of it.

[b][color=#ffff00]Tip[/color][/b]
Check the bottom of the screen to see the next object.

[b][color=#ffff00]Tap[/color][/b] anywhere to start...
